## Recraft V4 Pro API

Recraft V4 Pro is an image generation model by Recraft, available on the Venice API as `recraft-v4-pro`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

Recraft V4 Pro is the premium tier of Recraft V4, adding finer detail to its precise text rendering. It suits design, branding and product imagery where detail matters.

### Recraft V4 Pro API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `recraft-v4-pro` | Generate | Anonymized | $0.29 / image |

### Recraft V4 Pro specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Recraft |
| Released | Feb 12, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Aspect ratios | 1:1, 3:2, 16:9, 21:9, 9:16, 2:3, 3:4, 4:5 |
| Prompt limit | 10,000 characters |

### How to use the Recraft V4 Pro API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate` with `"model": "recraft-v4-pro"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "recraft-v4-pro",
    "prompt": "A retro travel poster with the bold headline \"VENICE\" in large condensed serif type, sunset color palette",
    "aspect_ratio": "1:1"
  }'
```
